title: Who are you
intro: One page per person who works with the AI in this repo. Your name, role and access go into CLAUDE.md, under The team and roles. The rest tells the AI how to work with you.

questions.text: What is your name, and what is your job in the agency?

parts.label: Your job
parts.ph: For example: account manager, editor, media buyer

questions.text: What access do you have in the OS?
questions.help: Owner and Admin can add people and change anyone's details. Member can change only their own details. Ask the owner if you are not sure.

questions.text: What do you do in a normal week?
questions.help: A few lines. For example: I write the copy for new campaigns and fix it after client feedback.

questions.text: How do you want the AI to answer you?
What must the AI never do without asking you first?
questions.help: For example: send anything to a client, spend money, delete a card.

questions.text: Which AI tool do you use?
